name: check-workflow
description: Check branch cleanup settings and releases read-only, remove duplicate ForgeSteward workflow rules, and safely consolidate tracked root Claude instructions into existing root AGENTS.md; submit cleanup as a PR or MR without merging. Release findings are reported only.

interface.shortDescription: Check releases; remove duplicate rules and consolidate entries.
interface.longDescription: Read branch cleanup settings and reconcile release tags, announcements, package feeds, prerelease flags, latest pointers and release runs against the repository release contract. Report release findings only. Remove duplicate ForgeSteward workflow rules, then safely consolidate tracked root Claude instructions into surviving root AGENTS.md. Preserve project conventions and submit cleanup as a PR or MR without merging. Repository settings stay unchanged; explicit check-only requests remain read-only.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $forge-steward-check-workflow to inspect branch cleanup settings and reconcile release evidence read-only, remove workflow policy rules that duplicate ForgeSteward skills (including legacy blocks), then safely consolidate tracked root Claude instructions into surviving root AGENTS.md under the bundled migration rules. Preserve project conventions and report release findings only. Validate, commit, push, and open a PR or MR for any cleanup without merging.
